summary: Verisk Analytics filed an 8-K solely to disclose that it filed a notice of appeal with the Delaware Supreme Court in the ongoing litigation Verisk Analytics, Inc. and Lenny Merger Sub, Inc. v. Exactlogix, Inc. d/b/a Acculynx.com and Richard Spanton. No deal terms, financial details, or strategic actions are provided. This is a routine legal-procedural update, not a special situation event. The appeal relates to prior litigation, but the filing itself does not announce a transaction, campaign, or other covered category. Nothing to watch from a risk-arb perspective.
